## ISL Exercise 4.8.1 (10pts)

Using a little bit of algebra, prove that (4.2) is equivalent to (4.3). In
other words, the logistic function representation and logit representation for the logistic regression model are equivalent.

$$p(X) = \frac{e^{\beta_0 + \beta_1 X}}{1 + e^{\beta_0 + \beta_1 X}}$$

$$\frac{p(X)} {1 − p(X)} = eβ_0+β_1X$$
We have $p(X) = \frac{e^{\beta_0 + \beta_1 X}}{1 + e^{\beta_0 + \beta_1 X}}$ by definition
Thus,
$$ 1-p(X)= 1- \frac{e^{\beta_0 + \beta_1 X}}{1 + e^{\beta_0 + \beta_1 X}}$$
Simplify with common denominator

$$ 1- \frac{e^{\beta_0 + \beta_1 X}}{1 + e^{\beta_0 + \beta_1 X}} = \frac{1 + e^{\beta_0 + \beta_1 X}-e^{\beta_0 + \beta_1 X}}{1 + e^{\beta_0 + \beta_1 X}} = \frac{1}{1 + e^{\beta_0 + \beta_1 X}} = 1-p(X)$$
Therefore,
$$\frac{p(X)}{1-p(X)} = \frac{(1 + e^{\beta_0 + \beta_1 X})e^{\beta_0 + \beta_1 X}}{1 + e^{\beta_0 + \beta_1 X}}=e^{\beta_0 + \beta_1 X}$$
